title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of this committee ensures Indian badminton players have a direct voice in the sport's governance and decision-making.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced the establishment of a new Athletes Committee, aimed at strengthening player representation and involvement in key organizational matters.

title: Junior World Championships Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This national coaching camp is crucial for preparing India's young talents for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, focusing on intensive training for the junior squad.

title: BAI Invites Applications for Players of Outstanding Merit
indian_angle: This initiative provides a pathway for exceptional Indian badminton players to receive recognition and support from the national body.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has opened applications for players demonstrating outstanding merit, offering opportunities for recognition and further development within the sport.

title: Advanced Coaches Course Held at NCE Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur is vital for enhancing the coaching standards across India, directly benefiting future Indian badminton players.
summary: BAI successfully conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, aiming to upgrade coaching expertise.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The adoption of the 3x15 scoring system in domestic junior events will significantly impact the development and match strategy of young Indian badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, effective from June 30, 2026.
